products.name: Valve Steam Machine
products.summary: Compact SteamOS living-room gaming PC with a semi-custom AMD Zen 4 CPU and RDNA3 GPU, up to 4K gaming with FSR 4.1.
products.description: Steam Machine is a small SteamOS gaming PC with a semi-custom AMD Zen 4 6C/12T CPU (up to 4.8 GHz) and a 28 CU RDNA3 GPU with 8 GB GDDR6, plus 16 GB DDR5. It outputs up to 4K 240Hz over DisplayPort 1.4 or 4K 120Hz over HDMI 2.0, includes a built-in Steam Controller wireless adapter, and remains an open PC you can install other software on.
products.keywords: steam machine valve steamos console pc living room

specs.cpu: Semi-custom AMD Zen 4, 6C/12T, up to 4.8 GHz
specs.gpu: Semi-custom AMD RDNA3, 28 CUs, 8 GB GDDR6
specs.networking: 2x2 Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3, integrated Steam Controller adapter

products.notes: Prices from the Steam store app API (app 4165910) for the US on 2026-09-28; sales have used a reservation queue. Image omitted: Valve's store assets are lifestyle photos on coloured backgrounds.

products.name: Valve Steam Controller
products.summary: Valve's 2026 Steam Controller with Steam Deck-style inputs, a USB-C wireless puck and 35+ hours of battery.
products.description: Steam Controller has the same familiar inputs as Steam Deck and works with PC, Steam Machine, Steam Deck and Steam Frame. It connects over a 2.4 GHz link (about 8 ms end-to-end) through the USB-C Steam Controller Puck, which supports up to four controllers, and its 8.39 Wh battery lasts 35+ hours.

specs.platform: Steam (PC, Steam Deck, Steam Machine, Steam Frame)
specs.connectivity: 2.4 GHz wireless via USB-C Steam Controller Puck

products.notes: Price from the Steam store app API (app 4165870) on 2026-09-28. Image omitted: no clean white-background official asset found.

products.name: Valve Steam Frame
products.summary: Streaming-first wireless VR headset running SteamOS on Snapdragon, with 2160x2160 LCDs per eye and standalone play.
products.description: Steam Frame is a wireless VR headset and PC that streams your Steam library from a PC over an included 6 GHz adapter or runs games standalone on a Snapdragon 8 Series processor with 16 GB LPDDR5X. It uses pancake lenses with 2160x2160 LCD panels per eye at 72-144 Hz, inside-out tracking with four cameras, and controllers that run about 40 hours on one AA battery.
products.keywords: steam frame vr headset valve steamos wireless

specs.display: 2160 x 2160 LCD per eye, 72-144 Hz, pancake lenses

products.name: Hisense UR9 RGB MiniLED 4K Google TV
products.summary: Hisense's 2026 RGB MiniLED TV with 100% BT.2020 colour, native 180Hz refresh and 4.1.2 Devialet-tuned sound.
products.description: The UR9 uses RGB MiniLED powered by Hisense Chromagic technology, generating red, green and blue light individually for True 100% BT.2020 coverage with Pantone Validated colour. It adds the Hi-View AI Engine RGB, an ultra-low reflection panel, a native 180Hz refresh rate and a 4.1.2 multi-channel sound system tuned by Devialet.
